description_en: Unlocks an office network based on a convenience account that has been automatically locked after being idle for a certain period
description_zh: 基于便捷账号的办公网络闲置一定时间后将被自动锁定。调用本接口可解锁
kebab_example: aliyun ecd activate-office-site --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-8037040000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ActivateOfficeSite

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the locked convenience office network
parameters.help_zh: 已锁定的便捷办公网络ID
parameters.name: office_site_id
